protocol: Frozen before the generator was changed in response to the first 21 torchvision samples' errors.
Never used to design or tune the generator, the prompts or the training; no model replies on it are opened before the final evaluation.
Scored once per final model: zero_shot prompt, all 17 samples, reply cap 8000 tokens (the longest reference, tvh-mobilenetv3-small, is 7220).
Reported with the unchanged scorer and scripts/classify_errors.py, blocks (14) and whole networks (3) separately.
build_large_dataset.py rejects any generated program topology-isomorphic to one of these graphs.

amendments.reason: The final setup is a two-adapter pipeline, not one model under the zero_shot prompt. It was chosen on development data only (torchvision 21; E1-E4 in docs/experiments.md), before any reply on this set was produced.
amendments.final_setup: qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-graphart-lora-mixed-v2 answers with the zero_shot prompt (reply cap 8000); the NODES of that reply are handed to qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-graphart-lora-wirer, which writes the edges with the brief step-2 prompt (pipeline/run_two_step.py --brief --step1-from, reply cap 8000). Greedy decoding, base Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct, fp16.
baselines: mixed-v2 alone: the same zero_shot replies the pipeline starts from, scored as they are.
The adapter of the 26 Oct submission (qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-graphart-lora), zero_shot, reply cap 8000.
Optional, in a separate session: Qwen2.5-Coder 14B (Ollama, Q4) zero_shot, reply cap 8000.
amendments.comparisons: Right graphs (scripts/classify_errors.py: exact, notation, spelling or commutative). Pipeline vs the submitted adapter, and pipeline vs mixed-v2 alone: exact McNemar on the discordant samples, n = 17, with Wilson 95% intervals.
amendments.unchanged: All 17 samples, scored once; the scorer and classifier unchanged; blocks (14) and whole networks (3) reported separately. Nothing is rerun, retuned or re-prompted after the replies are opened; a run that fails or is cut short is reported as it is.
